fieldValues.value: The canonical specification of the Semantic Record System (SRS): an open standard for portable semantic documents that both people and AI can understand, so that a complex unit of knowledge can be transferred intact rather than flattened into prose. SRS describes knowledge, never authority — the people who create knowledge own it and stay free to move it — and this repository practises that claim on itself: its records are the source of truth, and the rendered specification is a projection of them.
